definitions.gloss: familiarity from hearing, recognition by ear
definitions.explanation: The sense that one has heard something before — a voice, a name, a melody, or a phrase. Used when something sounds familiar even if one cannot pinpoint when or where it was heard.

examples.japanese: {聞|き}き{覚|おぼ}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧だった。
examples.english: It was a voice I recognized.
That name sounds familiar to me.

examples.japanese: {聞|き}き{覚|おぼ}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦メロディー→メロディー：05877_merodii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れて→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧きて、⟦{懐|なつ}かしい→懐かしい：02484_natsukashii⟧{気持|きも}ちになった。
examples.english: A familiar melody started playing, and I felt nostalgic.

notes:
USAGE:
The most common patterns are {聞|き}き{覚|おぼ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to sound familiar / to recognize from hearing) and {聞|き}き{覚|おぼ}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ + noun (a familiar-sounding ~). The negative {聞|き}き{覚|おぼ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ means something is not familiar at all.

Compare with the visual equivalent ⟦{見覚|みおぼ}え→見覚え：14134_mioboe⟧ (recognition by sight / visual familiarity).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {聞|き}き{覚|おぼ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to sound familiar
- {聞|き}き{覚|おぼ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to not sound familiar at all
- {聞|き}き{覚|おぼ}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: a familiar voice
- {聞|き}き{覚|おぼ}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧: a familiar-sounding name
